title: CoBRA: Programming Cognitive Bias in Social Agents Using Classic Social Science Experiments
reasoning: The paper focuses on programming and controlling cognitive biases (such as the framing effect, authority effect, and bandwagon effect) in LLM-based social agents using experiments from cognitive psychology and social science. While it discusses 'Research Ethics' as a section regarding the potential misuse of the tool to amplify societal biases or manipulate users, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
